Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, drug_indication.mesh_id AS mesh_id, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_curie, drug_indication.efo_id AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind From molecule_dictionary Join drug_indication On molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno Join molecule_dictionary As indications On drug_indication.molregno = indications.molregno Left Join compound_structures On indications.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Order By chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind
